Pipkin can\'t confirm this copy of Termux is the official F-Droid or Google Play build, so it won\'t use it. Uninstall it, then install Termux from F-Droid or Google Play (uninstalling deletes Termux\'s files).
Only official Termux, for your security

Your agent runs inside Termux, where it can reach your code, your files and the API keys you sign in with. A modified copy of Termux could read or change any of them, so before Pipkin runs anything, it checks that F-Droid or Google Play signed your copy. Termux from GitHub or anywhere else isn\'t accepted.
This Termux from Google Play is older than Pipkin supports.

Let Termux run in the background
Keeps Pipkin\'s helper in Termux running, so Pipkin starts without opening Termux. In Termux\'s app info, open App battery usage and choose Unrestricted.
Termux can run in the background.
Shows when Pipkin is working in the background and lets you stop it.
Lets Pipkin keep following a chat while the screen is off. Without it, Android can cut Pipkin off from the agent mid-run.
Pipkin can run in the background.
Allow Pipkin to run commands in Termux
Pipkin runs its agent through Termux.
Android won\'t ask again. In settings, open Permissions and allow \"Run commands in Termux environment\".
Pipkin can run commands in Termux.
In Termux, long-press, tap Paste, then press Enter. Allow storage access when Android asks. Termux brings you back here when it\'s done. If anything fails, paste the same command again.
